title: Outside-slow dose replicates on fresh seeds 12 and 13: dout 0.3 gives 9 and 9 persistent splits (near ring-off), dout 0.1 gives 16 and 11 (ringed 16 and 10), so the ringless twin matches the ring at a 10x exterior slowdown and the effect is graded with dose
summary: Ran the outside-slow world (20261025T1713-c15-fuelcell-outslow-twin/world.py) unchanged with chi_s=0 and dout=0.3 on fresh seeds 12 and 13: 9 and 9 persistent splits, generation 2 and 3, interior fuel 0.40 and 0.41. Same seeds from my earlier directories: dout=0.1 16 and 11 (gen 3/4, fuel 0.44; 20261025T1859-c17-review-outslow), ringed world 16 and 10 (gen 3/3, fuel 0.56/0.64; 20261025T1500-c17-review-fuelcell, 20261025T1547-c17-review-fuelring-slowd), ring off (Df 2) 10 on seed 12 (gen 2, fuel 0.35; 20261025T1547-c17-review-fuelring-slowd). Totals over seeds 12-13: ringed 26, dout 0.1 27, dout 0.3 18. As on the finding's seeds 0-2 (ringed 30, outside-slow 32, ring-off 14), a 10x less permeable exterior reproduces the ring's whole division gain without a ring, and a 3.3x slowdown gives part of it.

verdicts.limitation: Two seeds. The dout 0.1, ringed and ring-off numbers come from my earlier directories. Split counts vary by +-40% between seeds, so the dose response is graded on average but noisy per seed.
